name: Tears of Sulfuria
source: Two sisters, Marília and Adka, are torn apart by a traumatic event and must navigate a world that rejects them in order to find their way back to each other. Set in a dark fantasy world, the choices made by the player shape the future of the protagonists and the other characters from Sulfúria.
